async def act(page):
    import asyncio
    # Click the Reports link in the menubar to open its menu
    reports_link = page.get_by_role("menubar").get_by_role("link", name="\ue80a Reports")
    await reports_link.click()
    await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Wait for menu to appear
    # Click the Refunds link within the Reports menu
    # Assuming the Refunds link is under the Reports menu, use filter to locate it
    refunds_link = page.get_by_role("menubar").get_by_role("link", name="\ue80a Reports").get_by_role("menu").get_by_role("link", name="Refunds")
    await refunds_link.click()
    # Wait for the page to load after navigation
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    await asyncio.sleep(2)
